title: Standard B1s is deprecated in most Azure regions

blocks.heading: Standard B1s is deprecated in most Azure regions

blocks.text: Standard_B1s is deprecated in most Azure regions, please update bastion module default instance type to utilise a newer VM SKU e.g. Standard_B2ts_v2
This variable can be customised when calling modules directly but it breaks with zsac script (ideally refactor script to allow the bastion instance type to be specified?)
Bastion VM should be created correctly when running zsac up

│ Error: creating Linux Virtual Machine (Subscription: "38cdc06d-cf49-42ca-8b22-52ea60b94dab" │ Resource Group Name: "zsac-rg-kcx7y4nc" │ Virtual Machine Name: "zsac-southeastasia-zsac-rg-kcx7y4nc-bastion-vm-kcx7y4nc"): performing CreateOrUpdate: unexpected status 409 (409 Conflict) with error: SkuNotAvailable: The requested VM size for resource 'Following SKUs have failed for Capacity Restrictions: Standard_B1s' is currently not available in location 'southeastasia'. Please try another size or deploy to a different location or different zone. See https://aka.ms/azureskunotavailable for details. │ │   with module.bastion.azurerm_linux_virtual_machine.bastion_vm, │   on ../../modules/terraform-zsac-bastion-azure/main.tf line 66, in resource "azurerm_linux_virtual_machine" "bastion_vm": │   66: resource "azurerm_linux_virtual_machine" "bastion_vm" {
Simply use a newer VM type e.g. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/5727426/migrating-b1s-vm
Run zsac up in e.g. AustraliaSouthEast or SouthEastAsia
